_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for user-guide chapter order and numbering. The chapter NUMBER a reader sees is generated from this array position (1-based) by scripts/lib/user-guide-order.mjs -- it is NOT encoded in the filename. To add a chapter: create the file, add one line here in the position it should read, run `npm run build:user-guide-pdf`. Numbering re-flows on its own and no cross-reference breaks, because prose cites chapters by NAME, never by number. index.md is the contents page, not a numbered chapter. Filenames still carry legacy numeric prefixes; those become stable slugs in the restructure and this file is what makes that safe.
